fullDescription: A high-end, dark-mode marketplace aesthetic optimized for digital assets and premium SaaS platforms. The design features a deep 'Night' color palette (hsl(240, 8%, 4%)) paired with a vibrant electric blue accent (hsl(222, 100%, 56%)). It employs extensive glassmorphism, including floating navigation shells, backdrop blurs (40px), and complex inner shadows to simulate depth. Typography pairs the geometric Poppins for headings with JetBrains Mono for technical metadata and labels. Key features include infinite horizontal marquees, bento-grid layouts, scroll-triggered fade-ups, and a sophisticated mobile-first bottom navigation pill with a sliding glass active state.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sleek, premium dark-mode marketplace design for high-value digital assets. It uses glassmorphism, vibrant blue accents, and mono-spaced labels to create a trustworthy, high-tech atmosphere. The layout is structured with bento-style grids and infinite scrolling catalog elements.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system with a background of hsl(240, 8%, 4%). Primary accent color is electric blue hsl(222, 100%, 56%) with a secondary blue gradient to hsl(203, 100%, 62%). Typography: Use 'Poppins' for all body and headings; set large headings to font-weight 600 and letter-spacing -0.045em. Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all labels, prices, and tags. Spacing: 44px grid system. Glassmorphism: Floating elements must have backdrop-filter: blur(24px), a 1px border of rgba(255,255,255,0.1), and a complex inner shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.03), 0px 6px 16px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.16). Buttons: Primary buttons are solid blue with a 10px corner radius and a 0 10px 30px shadow of the accent color at 55% opacity. Secondary buttons are 'dashed-dark' style with a 1.5px dashed border and a breathing opacity animation.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Floating Header
Design a fixed header at the top with a 12px inset from the screen edges. Inside, place a 'float-shell'—a max-width 6xl container with a 14px radius, 1px border (hsl(240, 6%, 14%)), and 18px backdrop blur. The interior should feature a logo on the left, centered navigation links using 14px font-weight 500 text, and a search-styled shop button on the right.

### Hero Section
A 100svh section with a background image masked by a heavy top-down gradient (hsl(240, 8%, 4%) at 96% opacity to transparent). Center-align content: a mono-spaced badge with a pulsing dot, a massive H1 headline (font-size 3rem to 5rem) with a gradient-colored 'tilt' span, and two action buttons. Below, include a small platform-specific chip navigation with custom social media icons.

### Live Inventory Marquee
Create two rows of infinite horizontal scrolling marquee cards. The top row scrolls right, the bottom scrolls left. Each card is a small pill (8px radius, dark card background) containing a status dot, a title in Poppins, and a price in Mono-spaced font. Animation should be linear and take 25 seconds for a full loop.

### Process Section
A four-column bento grid titled 'The Process'. Each card has a 14px radius, 1px border, and contains a mono-spaced index number (e.g., 01), a themed icon in a blue-tinted box, a 1.125rem heading, and secondary-text descriptions. Add a hover state that changes the border color to the primary blue at 50% opacity.

### Featured Grid
A 2x4 or 4x1 grid of inventory cards. Each card displays a status tag (upper left), a status dot (upper right), a large truncated title (2xl), and a footer row with the price and a 'View' link that translates an arrow icon 2px on hover.

### Watermarked Footer
A large footer section containing a massive background text watermark ('handles.gg') at 17vw font-size, styled with a 1px stroke and transparent fill. Above it, include a newsletter signup bar with a glassmorphism input field, four columns of site links, and a social/language switcher row.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Mobile Navigation Pill — A floating bottom navigation bar for mobile devices.
A fixed bottom navigation bar 3rem from the screen bottom. It should be a pill-shaped container (radius 9999px) with a 2xl backdrop blur and a high-contrast inner shadow. It contains 5 icon slots. The active slot features a sliding background highlight—a rounded-rect with a subtle white border and inset shadow that transitions between icons using a cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.4, 0.45, 1) curve.

### Announcement Banner — A high-visibility notification card within the flow.
A container with a 12px radius, border-color #fbbf2473 (amber), and background of #f2b90d1a. It features an alert icon in a box and two levels of text hierarchy using amber for the label and high-contrast foreground for the body. Includes an inline 'See how' link with a right-pointing arrow.

### Lumen Card Hover — Advanced hover effect for call-to-action cards.
On hover, a card should display a conic-gradient border ('lumen-spin') that rotates 360 degrees. The card should lift -6px on the Y-axis and cast a wide glow shadow (hsl(var(--accent)/.55)).

style.description: The style essence is 'Modern Premium Dark'. Typography uses Poppins (Medium/Semibold) with negative tracking (-0.045em) for a compact, editorial look, paired with JetBrains Mono for data points. Colors revolve around a dark base (#0A0A0F), primary blue (#3370FF), and warning amber (#FBBF24). Interactive elements feature glassmorphism with 24px-40px blurs, 1px white borders at low opacity (10-20%), and 'glow' shadows on hover. Animations include 'ping' indicators for live status and 'fade-up' transitions for section entries.
